description: UDP time sync (contracts/packets/time_sync.md): the request a UE sends and the 24-byte reply the server builds from it, given the server's receive (t2) and send (t3) UTC times. Hex is lowercase, no separators.

cases.name: short_request_zero_padded
cases.notes: A request shorter than 8 bytes: the nonce is zero-padded.

cases.name: long_request_first_eight_bytes
cases.notes: Only the first 8 bytes are the nonce.
